parked.spanish: Y la traerá a hijos de Aarón, los sacerdotes, y tomará de allí lleno su puño desde su sólet y desde su aceite, sobre todo su incienso, y hará humear el sacerdote su memorial hacia el altar; ofrenda de fuego, olor de reposo a Jehová.

findings.issue: Common noun H5560 is left as the transliteration sólet; a non-name lemma must be Spanish.
Qal sequential H7061 (grasp, take a handful) is smoothed to generic tomará; the handful remains in the following noun.
Construct noun fullness-of plus his handful is smoothed to the adjective phrase lleno su puño; fullness, fist, and the 3ms suffix remain.
Construct chain fire-offering of odor of nichoach is smoothed by a comma into the apposition ofrenda de fuego, olor de reposo.
findings.spanishSpan: ofrenda de fuego, olor de reposo

parked.spanish: Y cuando acerques ofrenda de oblación, cocido de horno, tortas de flor de harina ázimas mezcladas en el aceite, y obleas ázimas untadas en el aceite.

findings.issue: סֹלֶת is construct and governs חַלּוֹת; tortas de flor de harina makes the absolute the head and the construct the genitive
cuando selects a temporal sense of the conjunction כִּי, which the morphology leaves open

readerNotes.note: Minjá se traduce oblación, no ofrenda, para que quede distinta de קרבן/'ofrenda' en la misma cláusula.
Elegí la forma femenina sustantivada 'la restante' en vez de agregar un sustantivo explícito, para igualar el género del participio hebreo sin cambiar el sentido.
Minjá is rendered oblación, not ofrenda, so it stays distinct from קרבן/tu ofrenda in the same verse.

The copula *es* is supplied in italics to complete the verbless Hebrew clause now that minjá reads as ofrenda; partirás keeps the 2ms person already set by the surrounding verbs, which is licensed grammatical smoothing of a non-finite infinitive absolute, not a person change.
Minjá is rendered oblación, not ofrenda, so it stays distinct from קרבן/tu ofrenda in the same verse.
Chose presentará for H7126 and kept acercará for H5066 so the two distinct hiphil verbs no longer share one Spanish word.
Chose 'ofrenda' for H4503 (minjá); this repeats the word already used for 'ofrenda de fuego' (H801) earlier in the verse.
Added con before leudado so the masculine noun names what the offering is made of, not an adjective disagreeing in gender with la ofrenda.
Added 'ellas' only to mark the subject of 'no subirán' as the offerings, not the addressees of 'acercarán'; both verbs share the Spanish -án ending.
Chose 'oblación' as the Spanish common noun for H4503 (מנחה) in both occurrences, distinct from 'ofrenda' used for H7133 (קרבן) elsewhere in the verse.
Chose the feminine noun espiga tierna for aviv, so the participle was adjusted to tostada to agree in gender; no clause roles or participants were changed.
Supplied the copula *es* (italicized) for the verbless הִוא clause, as done for the same construction in Levítico 2:6.
